# Checklist

<!-- You can open the pull request with items unchecked. Before the merge, each item is either done or does not apply. -->

- [ ] I have read the [contribution guide](https://tileverse.io/developer-guide/how-to/contribute/).
- [ ] I have read and applied the [AI policy](https://tileverse.io/ai/).
- [ ] The pull request targets the `main` branch (backports come later).

For source code changes:

- [ ] New unit tests cover the change.
- [ ] The [documentation](https://github.com/tileverse-io/tileverse/tree/main/docs/src) is updated, if users can see the change.
- [ ] A [GitHub issue](https://github.com/tileverse-io/tileverse/issues) describes the change, unless users see no difference.
- [ ] A bug fix or a small feature is a single commit.
- [ ] Each commit has a single goal.

The pull request is merged when the build checks are green, a maintainer has reviewed it, and the checklist is complete.
